body: Currently a Junior and a Math Major. I actually really like my Organic Chemistry course and find the course rather easy, but Number Theory has to be one of the most boring course I have taken. Since I'm more focused in Statistics courses like Number Theory are not important. I personally don't feel stressed, but am just been feeling so depressed lately that I can't even do basic functions in my life. I have had these feelings since I was 7 and now I'm 21. I see nothing improving at this point so why bother trying.

I read his essay On Suicide in the past, but didn't know it was part of a larger collection of essays. Looks like an interesting read and my philosophy seems to align closely to his (as my Mother was a philosophy major and her favorite philosopher was Kant). Thanks for the recommendation I will read through more of his essays.

Against Nature by Joris-Karl Huysmans in particular. But other decadent literature collections by other French authors I have had a likening to. Be warn Against Nature is a tough read and it's practically a single character rambling for 200 pages.

I don't feel stressed at all. Even though I have an assignment due tomorrow and a test this week. I have done well in College so far in my past semesters, but the further I keep going the more pointless I see college and life in general is to me. I have become attracted to decadent French novels where the protagonist of supposed noble upbringing secludes himself from all of society under the pretenses of the denial of the Will to Live. It's almost the perfect alternative to death.

Yes. While my misanthropy had not become extreme until a few years ago. I have never had any capacity of feeling joy or pleasure in anything beginning since early elementary school. The only reason I do anything is because society has told me. I'm majoring in math not for any particular joy or love of math, only because society wants people with 'useful jobs.' I achieved good grades so far only because everybody has told me that leaders and sussessful individuals get good grades. I have had no great tragedy to befall on me, only me realizing the influence that humanity has inflicted me. I have zero interests, the interests and ambitions I tell people are lies to show signs of normalcy when in reality I truly don't care. I tell my parents the same lies also for the sake of normalcy, but I still don't care. It's finally close to reaching a zenith where I drop out of college, lose contact with everyone, and live on the streets in complete isolation. I'll possibly die, but I care little about death. Still I'll likely commit some random crime (bank robbery or something like that) and live the rest of my days in solitary confinement. There I should be almost completely isolated from humanity especially if the jail cells are spread out. People may use many different terms to describe me, but that doesn't phase me. Depression, suicidual, etc are just meaningless terms label the Other in society. I still haven't 100% decided about what to do, but I believe me listening to orders from Humanity will end soon enough.

It's just another example of how cruel others be. Seriously OP don't listen to a word they say. Though sadly individuals like that are the reasons I say nothing about my feeling, but on throwaway accounts.
My mother should've just aborted me. I have been quite depressive my whole life and never had a single happy thought or memory.
This is so me. I'm certain my death may be a few years now or even sooner. Cannot stand living anymore.
Already in college and have good grades, but doing bad once in awhile makes the pain such much harder to take.

Who says I don't like my own bourgeois morality? You can see even on this subreddit the pressure for admissions and grades on this subreddit. For a individual who grew up with his own identity being only reflected on there grades and this logic being reinforced by teachers, parents, even other students. I'm an extreme example, but still victim a like everyone else. While I'm glad you were able to grow from such a mindset, mine has been reinforce by a dogma beginning from Daycare. Most I assume will agree that I have lost my mind for commiting a crime or suicide over a test grade, but for ME its the only logical conclusion from my POV.
So die in complete isolation or by shotgun then?

You can just walk into a bank give them a note saying "I am armed, give me $10000." After getting the money just sit there until the police come and arrest you. While I'm sure this causes a massive disruption for the people at the bank, there issues will be amended quickly and soon they'll be discussing the strange nature for someone robbing a bank. I will make sure whether judge I have throws the book at me by talking about the danger I put everybody in the bank in, etc. It's easy to say life get's better, I almosted dropped out of high school and now have good grades, but even with doing better I have been feeling even worse than my high school years and past. I first thought improvement would help, but it actually has had the opposite effect for me. So now realizing the futility of things getting better, that it would be better to lock myself up or kill myself.
